name: Blendful Lane Center
author: xpilot plugin port; Blendful by Discountchubbs, royjr, nayan8teen, rav4kumar and sunnypilot contributors
description: Alpha lane-center blend: adds a clipped curvature correction toward the visual lane center and draws a blue center line. Enable while parked. The host caps the correction at 0.5 m/s^2 and SP's clip_curvature still applies.
